#!/bin/bash
TRAIN_PID=211098
CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_cwm14b_func_s42"
EVAL_GPU=1

echo "[$(date)] Watching CWM 14B training PID=$TRAIN_PID..."

while kill -0 $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 60
done

echo "[$(date)] CWM 14B training finished. Finding best checkpoint..."

BEST_CKPT=$(python3 -c "
import json, glob, os
states = glob.glob('$CKPT_DIR/checkpoint-*/trainer_state.json')
if not states:
    ckpts = sorted(glob.glob('$CKPT_DIR/checkpoint-*'), key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[-1]))
    print(ckpts[-1] if ckpts else '')
else:
    latest = max(states, key=os.path.getmtime)
    s = json.load(open(latest))
    best = s.get('best_model_checkpoint', '')
    if best and os.path.exists(best):
        print(best)
    else:
        ckpts = sorted(glob.glob('$CKPT_DIR/checkpoint-*'), key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[-1]))
        print(ckpts[-1] if ckpts else '')
")

echo "[$(date)] Best checkpoint: $BEST_CKPT"

if [ -z "$BEST_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "[$(date)] ERROR: No checkpoint found!"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cwm14b_func_s42/

echo "[$(date)] Starting CWM 14B eval on GPU $EVAL_GPU..."
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$EVAL_GPU python3 eval_cwm_baseline.py \
    --data_dir data/ \
    --checkpoint_dir "$BEST_CKPT" \
    --model_name /dev/shm/Qwen3-14B \
    --output /root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cwm14b_func_s42/eval_cwm_results.json \
    --batch_size 1 \
    --max_seq_length 2048 \
    --max_new_tokens 64 \
    --save_predictions

echo "[$(date)] CWM 14B eval DONE. Results:"
cat /root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cwm14b_func_s42/eval_cwm_results.json
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/auto_eval_cwm14b.sh
